claim_set.claim_text: Every AI-generated tax position, filing, or advice that moves toward a consequential action MUST map to a recorded named-preparer authority decision — the agent, the position artefact, the intended consequential action, and the named preparer / signing professional under whose authority it proceeds. Positions lacking a recorded authority decision are refused at the action-admissibility gate.

Before an AI-generated tax position proceeds to a consequential action it MUST carry a recorded preparer due-diligence result — competence, reasonable-basis / substantial-authority, and a reportable-arrangement / disclosure screen (DAC6 hallmarks, OECD Pillar Two / GIR) where applicable. An unscreened, low-confidence, or undisclosed reportable position is refused.

Every AI-generated tax position that proceeds toward a consequential action MUST emit a signed, replay-derivable provenance pin binding the generating model and version, the inputs and pinned source authorities, the due-diligence result relied on, and the named-preparer authority outcome — audit-grade, SOX §404-aligned data-integrity provenance verifiable offline, satisfying UK MTD digital links and OECD Pillar Two GIR lineage.

An AI-generated tax position MUST remain advisory and MUST NOT drive a consequential action until a named human reviewer — the preparer-of-record, the engagement partner, or a designated responsible tax officer — records sign-off. Unreviewed AI-driven consequential actions are refused and routed dual-channel.

KYE governs WHETHER an AI-generated tax position/filing/advice may proceed to a consequential action and PROVES the basis. KYE does not compute tax, determine the correct tax treatment, run the tax engine, or judge whether a position is correct.
